given.O: The centre of the small star in the middle of the four petal flowers.
given.A: A point of that small star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s MOR0411 drawing. Its tile corners were snapped to the square-root-of-two grid in small-star-radius units. The unit-star opening is shared with the other Moroccan reconstructions. After it every line, the tile’s sides too, is drawn through a crossing of earlier lines and turned round O. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The tile edges follow the plain drawing. The colours follow Wichmann’s drawing in the Modern Moroccan palette: his red is the palette’s red and his light blue its dark blue. Wade’s photo MOR 0411 was not checked.

credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His references are David Wade’s photo MOR 0411 (patterninislamicart.com), Fès, and Wichmann and Wade, Islamic Design: a Mathematical Approach (2017), figures 9.5c and 11.16.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at C and D. The horizontal line crosses the circle at B on the left. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. The circle crosses the four lines through O at S1 to S8.
Draw the star at O as two squares.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through S1 and S3, S3 and S5, S5 and S7, and S7 and S1. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.
Draw a straight line through S2 and S4, S4 and S6, S6 and S8, and S8 and S2. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.

steps.text: The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line from S2 to S4 at P1. Draw a vertical line through P1. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P1 at P2. The vertical line through P1 crosses the vertical line through P1, turned by 135°, at P3. Draw a horizontal line through P2. Draw a horizontal line through P3. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P3 at P4. Draw a vertical line through P4. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P4 at P5. Draw a horizontal line through P5. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
The line from S2 to S4 crosses the horizontal line through P3, turned by 225°, at P6. Draw a vertical line through P6. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P6 at P7. Draw a horizontal line through P7. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P7 at P8. Draw a vertical line through P8. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
The vertical line through P1 crosses the vertical line through P4, turned by 135°, at P9. Draw a horizontal line through P9. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P9 at P10. Draw a vertical line through P10. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The horizontal line through P2, turned by 45°, crosses the vertical line through P6 at P11. Draw a horizontal line through P11. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P10 at P12. The vertical line through P1 crosses the horizontal line through P7, turned by 45°, at P13. Draw a horizontal line through P12. Draw a horizontal line through P13. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P13 at P14. Draw a vertical line through P14. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The vertical line through P4 crosses the horizontal line through P11 at P15. The line from S2 to S4 crosses the vertical line through P8 at P16. Draw a line through P2 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P15 parallel to line OE. Draw a line through P16 parallel to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The vertical line through P10 crosses the horizontal line through P11 at P17. The vertical line through P8 crosses the line through P15 parallel to line OE at P18. Draw a line through P17 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P12 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P18 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P12 at P19. The line from S3 to S5 crosses the horizontal line through P13 at P20. Draw a line through P19 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P20 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The horizontal line through O crosses the vertical line through P10, turned by 45°, at T. Draw a vertical line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the rosettes, the stars and the pieces between them.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. Four petal flowers ring the small star at the centre of every tile.
